summary.text: Stephen "Steve" Woll, an independent Navy veteran, scientist, and businessman, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Virginia's 3rd District to Bobby Scott.
According to his campaign website, he grew up in Pittsburgh and has lived in Hampton Roads for more than 25 years.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Woll grew up in Pittsburgh and lived in several places before the Navy brought him to Hampton Roads more than 25 years ago.

He says he attended Officer Candidate School and served 21 years in the Navy as a Meteorology and Oceanography Officer, including aboard the USS Harry S. Truman on September 11, a deployment supporting Operation Iraqi Freedom, and a final assignment commanding support operations for a dozen aircraft carriers and large-deck amphibious ships across the Atlantic Fleet.

After leaving the Navy, Woll says, he worked in the private sector helping companies and clients use data, technology, and teamwork on operational problems, including public-private partnerships in Hampton Roads.
He adds that he has for several years worked with a veteran-inspired service organization focused on civic divides.
During the campaign, he said he was running as a representative who answers to the district rather than to a party.
He received 1.6% of the vote to Bobby Scott's 72.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
